profile_text.body:
Apollo Global Management is a public company traded under the ticker APO. On its own website, Apollo describes itself as an asset manager, a capital provider, and a provider of wealth and retirement solutions. It says it creates strategies it calls innovative and differentiated, and it presents private credit as a way to promote resiliency in financial systems, fuel business growth, and power retirement income. The site also highlights long-duration capital and aviation expertise, and it says Apollo and Athene have been delivering investment solutions across the retirement ecosystem for more than three decades. Apollo states it is addressing the approximately $90T worth of investments needed to power what it calls the Global Industrial Renaissance.

The harvested material does not list any specific AI products or services from the company. No lawsuits, no MCP servers, and no products are recorded in the held facts, and the site text centers on private markets, credit, retirement, and aviation rather than artificial intelligence.
